caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular design divided into three main sections arranged as a square on the left side with two narrow rectangles stacked vertically on the right. The color palette includes red, green, and a background of light beige. The largest square section on the left displays a symmetrical floral pattern with a central red flower surrounded by green stems and leaves, and smaller red buds at regular intervals. The upper right vertical rectangle features a winding green vine with green leaves and multiple red flower buds. The lower right rectangle continues the vine motif, including green leaves and red flower heads, one of which is fully bloomed. The green and red elements are outlined clearly, and the background of each section is crosshatched with light diagonal gray lines. The entire composition is enclosed in a thin green rectangular border.
title: Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
